title: SB307 (2022 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Senate Draft 1, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2022/bills/SB307_SD1_.HTM; sha256 b2b8b9ae33d3ea512e38903f81862ea2fb5f33db068c1e7277aa87a5068ed8e1)
provenance.note: Senate Draft 1 (same text in 2022). The quote leaves out words the draft strikes ("or", "teflon"). Effective date in this draft is May 6, 2137.

operative_text: SECTION 2 (HRS 134-8): The manufacture, possession, sale, barter, trade, gift, transfer, or acquisition of any of the following is prohibited: assault pistols, except as provided by section 134-4(e); automatic firearms; rifles with barrel lengths less than sixteen inches; shotguns with barrel lengths less than eighteen inches; any firearm or rifle with the capacity to fire ammunition of fifty caliber or higher except shotguns and muzzle-loading firearms; cannons; mufflers, silencers, or devices for deadening or muffling the sound of discharged firearms; hand grenades, dynamite, blasting caps, bombs, bombshells, or other explosives; or any type of ammunition or any projectile component thereof coated with Teflon or any other similar coating designed primarily to enhance its capability to penetrate metal or pierce protective armor; and any type of ammunition or any projectile component thereof designed or intended to explode or segment upon impact with its target.
